summary: Read the ten room pages and the targets' frontmatter and passages that bear on each of the 36 links. Result: 36 verdicts, 23 label, 1 retype (Floquet Time-Modulated Loops to Progressive Staging as exemplifies), 12 cut, 0 keep. The pattern: links with a sentence on either page labelled cleanly (Categorizing Inharmonicity, Floquet Theory's philosopher visit, Floquet Loops' Bloch and FM passages); the cuts are almost all unsaid pairs where neither page names the other (Shepard Tone's three, Dispersion to Compressor Design and Bessel, DSP Frameworks to JSUI and Preset Oracle, Bessel to Action Potential Oscillator). Several pairs are also held in reverse, bare, on pages outside this room (Dispersion and Categorizing Inharmonicity, Dispersion and Shimmer Cloud, Bessel and Crystal Synthesizer), so the weaver should keep one direction per pair. Not settled: the Portamento label is thin (low confidence), and whether Dispersion should add a reverb section is Loudon's call. No genuine inbound links found for the newcomer entries from these pages.
